recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-28558 unless a separate work group decision changes the Common Languages membership policy or asks to synchronize regional dialects into the separate written-languages starter value set.
issue_request: FHIR-28558 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request asking to add fr-CA to the Common Languages value set because French-Canadian translations were being shown as French (France). The issue was applied for R5 with a 2021-07-12 vote of 17-0-0.
initial_application: Git commit e3e1b52ba65a3469e9d48047f4e03cae426e685f explicitly applied FHIR-28558 by adding fr-CA / French (Canada) to source/terminologies/valueset-languages.xml. Later terminology maintenance changed ordering and designation metadata, but preserved the concept.
additional_context: source/terminologies/valueset-languages.xml remains the source for http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/languages / CommonLanguages, and Resource.language plus the common Language binding still reference that value set as the starter/common language list. FHIR-I minutes confirm the FHIR-28558 persuasive vote, and a 2019 Zulip thread provides background that fr-CA was missing from the recommended Common Languages list. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. An empty no-change audit commit was published because the current source already contains the requested fr-CA concept with display French (Canada).

related_jiras.note: Later Common Languages work added additional regional European language codes without removing or contradicting fr-CA.
